name: solder
description: A lean coding agent in a side panel, for any OpenAI-compatible endpoint with tool calling.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Solder edits files in the workspace.

solder.endpoint.markdownDescription: The full Chat Completions address, ending in `/chat/completions`. The key is set with **Solder: Set API key**.

solder.model.description: The model new chats use (each chat can pick its own beside Send).

solder.modelFilter.description: A regular expression: only models whose id matches it are offered (for example, only tool-calling ones).

solder.modelNames.markdownDescription: Short names for the model picker: `{ "<model id>": "<name>" }`.

enumDescriptions: Much more thought: slower, and uses significantly more tokens.

solder.compactAtTokens.description: Summarise the older part of a chat once it passes this many tokens. Every step resends the whole chat, so lower costs less.

solder.maxRounds.description: The most replies with tool calls for one message.

solder.rules.description: Your rules for the model, a few plain lines, added to every chat.

solder.instructionFiles.description: Project instruction files the model follows, by file name only: the one at the workspace root, and the nearest one when it reads files in a subfolder.

solder.storageLimitGB.markdownDescription: The most disk space, in GB, that Undo's backups may use (the copies Solder keeps before each change). Past it, the oldest go first; there's no time limit. Deleting a chat removes its backups.

about.description: A few words on what's in it, so the model knows when to look there.

solder.docsFolders.markdownDescription:
Folders of your own reference docs (APIs, schematics, specifications) that the model can search, in every workspace. Each is a path, or `{ "path": "…", "about": "…" }`. Indexed on this PC only; only the passages the model looks at are sent.

**What's searched:** any plain text (`.txt`, `.md`, `.rst`, `.html`, `.xml`, `.json`, `.yaml`, `.csv`, `.log`, code and headers such as `.c`, `.h`, `.py`, `.cs`, `.ps1`…, in UTF-8 or UTF-16) and Word, Excel and PowerPoint (`.docx`, `.xlsx`, `.pptx`, and their macro versions).

**Not searched:** PDFs, images and scans, the old `.doc`, `.xls` and `.ppt` formats, and files over 5 MB (40 MB for Office files). Up to 20,000 files per folder; `.git` and `node_modules` are skipped.

Add one with **Use as Solder docs** on a folder in the Explorer.
